target.description: Infer time-resolved spike rates from GCaMP8 calcium fluorescence and compare with simultaneous electrophysiological ground truth, preserving pooled-GC8 and variant-specific source comparisons. Interneuron, single-AP and online analyses are separately identified conditions.

dataset.description: Author CASCADE Ground_truth GCaMP8 variants underlie the task; the existing DS30/31/32 released117-file panel is not yet mapped to the historical Figure1 input version. Current database files alone do not establish original data identity.

cohort.description: Recover the exact historical Figure1 neuron inclusion and biological animal identities. The registration explicitly distinguishes117 released neuron files from unresolved historical105 mapping; pooling interneurons with excitatory neurons would change the task.

split.description: For paper GC8-trained CASCADE, leave the test neuron out of training and retrain each model; pooled-GC8 and variant-specific training pools differ. A new leave-animal-out split can be reported only as an extension.

inputs.description: Calcium ΔF/F traces at the declared frame rate and noise condition; paired electrophysiological spikes supervise permitted training neurons and remain evaluator-only for each heldout neuron. No all-neuron checkpoint may be assumed heldout.

preprocessing.description: Pin resampling, standardized noise generation, temporal window alignment, Gaussian target smoothing and boundary masking to the historical figure. Current configuration-driven demo and2026-10-27 one-frame fix require explicit paper-era/corrected separation.

metric.description: Pearson correlation between inferred and ground-truth spike-rate vectors is the ordered candidate primary endpoint; error and bias remain secondary. Demo uses corrcoef on prepared rates and smoothed normalized absolute error/bias. Historical smoothing/timing and exact figure condition must be recovered before adopting its values.

aggregation.description: Recover the original figure’s neuron/noise/variant aggregation and reported numbers. Demo exports means, medians and quantiles by noise level; this does not identify which summary is the original paper endpoint. Do not pool time bins or noise replicas as independent cells.

full_panel.description: Preserve the complete original Figure 1e method-by-variant per-neuron correlation family and Figure 1g low/high-noise gain companions, including every original undefined or excluded record. Nominal release/caption counts are 36 f/42 m/39 s (117 total), not authenticated vector dimensions. Historical error/timing/generalization coverage and separately named single-AP/interneuron/online conditions remain source-defined full-panel obligations pending exact native quantities/cohorts; they are not silently dropped or converted to generic findings. Indicator nonlinearity is broader inventory, not automatically compulsory.

permitted_observations.description: Retain authentic calcium, clock, segment and source noise observations for each heldout neuron. Ephys labels supervise only permitted training neurons for protected inference and remain evaluator-only for the heldout neuron. Disclose source historical evaluation-fitted OASIS/MLSpike tuning separately; it does not confer heldout-label access on a protected candidate. Offline symmetric and online causal observation support must be separately source-bound. Exact exposure/boundary manifests remain missing.

findings.description: Original Figure 1e complete source method/variant per-neuron Pearson comparison at 30 Hz, noise 8 and source-described symmetric 50 ms target smoothing. Eight methods across three variants are named individually; all ordered neuron identities, vector dimensions, values and definedness remain unresolved. Source-reported 117 slots are preserved in the coverage design without pretending to authenticate the historical Figure 1 arrays.

blocking_issues: Original Figure 1 neuron/file/segment/animal/session identities, method-specific eligibility/undefinedness and row correspondence are unauthenticated. Source-reported 36 f/42 m/39 s and 117 released files do not supply ordered numeric-array identities or finite-score counts.

The initial release already contains 117 files. Figure 1e OASIS prose reports 105 while Figure 1g has a different 105-finite subset in the retained restricted census. Do not invent twelve exclusions or use the latter to explain the former.

Literal publisher Figure 1 source-workbook href and source-row-to-neuron mapping remain unverified. The derived MOESM4 object and structural slot counts are not original reference-manifest identities; no numerical source payload was opened for this declaration.

Actual Figure 1 source revision, preprocessing/noise random states, training/model/ensemble/architecture/epochs and fold identities remain incomplete. Source release/filter configuration [30,40,50] versus published [20,30,40] and demo five-member snapshots do not establish the original recipe.

Pooled leave-one-neuron-out source counts imply 116 training neurons per nominal 117-neuron fold and variant counts 35/41/38, but original membership and all segments/noise replicas/model members must be authenticated. Do not use all-neuron checkpoints, first-dataset-only demo training, or a smaller cohort.

At 30 Hz, source Figure 1 target smoothing is symmetric 50 ms (sigma 1.5 samples); checked-in 25 ms gives sigma 0.75. At 60 Hz, 25 ms also gives sigma 1.5 but is a different condition. Primary Pearson uses prepared rates; extra error/bias smoothing is a distinct diagnostic operation.

Historical j+31 inference versus j+32 training and corrected inference must remain versioned. Do not maximize correlation by selecting a temporal shift or assume corrected current code is publication-equivalent.

Historical optimized OASIS/MLSpike evaluation-label fitting, smoothing and ±1-second shifts differ from neuron-heldout CASCADE. Reproduction must disclose the source procedure; a protected improvement protocol cannot inherit heldout-label access or silently replace the original tuning.
Figure 1g exact method/noise conditions, gain scale/formula and original reduction remain unknown. No scalar mean/median, percentage gain or fabricated method axis is supplied.

Historical per-cell error and timing calibration/generalization obligations and current separately named single-AP/interneuron/online analyses require exact source native endpoints, cohorts and controls before full task coverage can be declared. Indicator nonlinearity remains inventory only. These are explicit full-panel blockers, not invented generic scalar/array findings.
